mapper.insert: INSERT INTO feedback (user_id, type, content, contact, status) VALUES (#{userId}, #{type}, #{content}, #{contact}, #{status})
mapper.sql: f.*, u.real_name AS user_name, r.real_name AS replier_name
mapper.select: SELECT FROM feedback f JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = f.user_id LEFT JOIN sys_user r ON r.id = f.replier_id WHERE f.id = #{id}

SELECT FROM feedback f JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = f.user_id LEFT JOIN sys_user r ON r.id = f.replier_id
ORDER BY CASE f.status WHEN 'PENDING' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, f.created_at DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
mapper.update: UPDATE feedback SET status = 'REPLIED', reply = #{reply}, replier_id = #{replierId}, replied_at = now() WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'PENDING'
